WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
yr AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT r.store_id, d.fiscal_year, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl_net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE r.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT y.store_id, cs.store_name, y.fiscal_year, ROUND(y.net_sales,0) net_sales, ROUND(c.ctl_net,0) ctl_net, ROUND(y.net_sales-c.ctl_net,0) diff,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY y.fiscal_year ORDER BY y.net_sales DESC) rnk
FROM yr y JOIN ctl c USING (store_id, fiscal_year)
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=y.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE y.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
QUALIFY rnk <= 14
ORDER BY y.fiscal_year, rnk

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.sales_line_id, f.etl_loaded_at
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id=116 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
rets AS (
    SELECT r.return_date AS business_date, -r.refund_net AS net_sales
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id=116 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT business_date, SUM(net_sales) n FROM (SELECT business_date, net_sales FROM net_lines UNION ALL SELECT business_date, net_sales FROM rets) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.business_date, ROUND(m.n,2) mine, ROUND(r.net_sales,2) ctl, ROUND(m.n-r.net_sales,2) diff, r.net_sales_before_returns, r.returns_net
FROM mine m JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=m.business_date AND r.store_id=116
WHERE ABS(m.n-r.net_sales) > 0.01
ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'dup_keys_all' AS what, count(*) AS n_groups, sum(c) AS n_rows, sum(c-1) AS extra_rows, min(dt) mind, max(dt) maxd
FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c, min(sale_date) dt FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_in_116_wk', count(*), sum(c), sum(c-1), min(dt), max(dt)
FROM (SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, count(*) c, min(f.sale_date) dt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=116 GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id', count(*), sum(c), sum(c-1), min(dt), max(dt)
FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, count(*) c, min(sale_date) dt FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)

WITH sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
yr AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl_net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE r.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY y.net_sales DESC) AS rank, y.store_id, cs.store_name, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, ROUND(y.net_sales,2) AS net_sales,
       ROUND(c.ctl_net,2) AS ctl_net, ROUND(y.net_sales - c.ctl_net, 2) AS diff,
       (SELECT MAX(ABS(y2.net_sales - c2.ctl_net)) FROM yr y2 JOIN ctl c2 USING (store_id)) AS max_abs_diff_all_stores
FROM yr y JOIN ctl c USING (store_id)
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = y.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank
LIMIT 12
